I've replied to Pree in your DM with her cutoff date for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork: 21 October. She told me that on 14 October, and it's the latest date she's given me.

**The note I saved isn't coming back:** I got the date from re-reading your DM history, not from the gbrain note I saved last time. Looking up her name in gbrain found nothing. Gbrain says this kind of connection can only read facts open to the whole workspace, so marking her note "private" probably hid it from me. That means the note can't be relied on to remember things for her.

**One fix to consider:** My wrap-up from last time ended up in her DM as a separate message, and it talks about her as "Pree" rather than to her. It's her own DM, so nothing reached anyone else, but you may want to delete it.
